Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
With all our weekly check-ins canceled, we finally have a little time to give the break room that makeover we’ve been talking about for years. Not too much. Rearrange the furniture. Slap a fresh coat of gooseberry red on the accent wall. And, you know what? Let’s bundle all the shimmering foils together to hang from the ceiling like a disco ball—just a little razzle dazzle. Oh yeah, that new art looks great up there. That’s a bundle with style.
